I suspect reaction_service.go was missed by the grep for store.Memo. I will verify whether it contains references to the struct.

The grep pattern `store\.Memo[^A-Za-z]` failed to catch `*store.Memo` because the `[^A-Za-z]` regex requires a non-letter character after `Memo`. This explains why some files were missed.

reaction_service.go does reference store.Memo. The full set of packages needing review includes:

- github.com/usememos/memos/store
- github.com/usememos/memos/store/db/sqlite

Additional packages requiring review include github.com/usememos/memos/server/router/rss and github.com/usememos/memos/server/router/frontend (test-only).

proto/gen/store/memo.pb.go defines MemoPayload instead of store.Memo.

The postgres GetMemo and sqlite implementations may handle memo fields differently.

store/db/user_delete might scan memo fields without using the store.Memo type.
